chapters.title: Start
chapters.caption: A real recording of the app on a phone, in a demo shop: Mama Tee Stores, and Amaka, its storekeeper.

chapters.title: The stock
chapters.caption: Amaka’s phone: every product in the shop, how much is left, and what is running low.

chapters.title: A delivery
chapters.caption: A delivery arrives: 2 bags of rice. Quick mode: find it, tap the amount.

chapters.title: Bags and kilos
chapters.caption: Recorded and sent. 2 bags is 100 kg: the app does the sum.

chapters.title: No network
chapters.caption: Now the network drops. A customer buys 3 kg of rice. Amaka records it anyway.

chapters.title: Saved on the phone
chapters.caption: Saved on the phone, marked RECORDED. Nothing is lost, and there is nothing to retype.

chapters.title: Back online
chapters.caption: Back online: it sends itself, exactly once. RECORDED turns SYNCED.

chapters.title: Up to date
chapters.caption: The stock list is right: 497 kg of rice.

chapters.title: A count
chapters.caption: Count the shelf. The app expects 497 kg of rice; Amaka finds 487.

chapters.title: What is missing
chapters.caption: 10 kg is missing, shown straight away, while people still remember what happened.

chapters.title: Who did what
chapters.caption: The owner’s phone: every change carries a name and a time. Amaka’s delivery, sale and count.

chapters.title: Get started
chapters.caption: Send us your product list and we load it within 24 hours.
